name: Story: the last road (SC13)
notes: STORY steg 6, the morning act. Started by morning_ward. The old SC13 'The road to Roswell' (S47Chapter6: the objective to the courier, past C without stopping) on Freeform's own truck: the objective, then the story waits for the player at the wheel (or its most) and goes on to the end (morning_end). Left out: the old road with its mile posts, the 10.4 COURIER sign and the survey bolt at C (the old chapter's own road; Freeform's map has none of them).

beats.text: The truck. Get the originals to the courier, and don't stop at C.
The sheets on the seat beside me. Don't stop.
